description: This Java class implements a generic SQL-backed blocking queue with asynchronous processing, batching, and stats tracking, used within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: TbSqlBlockingQueue
classes.description: A generic, thread-safe, batched SQL queue with asynchronous processing and stats collection.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the queue processing thread, sets up batching, sorting, and scheduled stats logging.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service, stopping queue processing.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an element to the queue and returns a future for the result.
